sessions.title: A Talking about films and books
sessions.description_vi: Thảo luận về phim ảnh và sách.
sessions.value:
# Films and books

## A Talking about films and books

When a new book or film comes out, newspapers and websites, like BookLikes and IMDb, will review it. The people who review the book/film are called **book reviewers / film critics** and they write **book/film reviews**. If they don’t like a book/film they give it a bad review.

We can say that a novel or film is **based on a true story**. We say that a **book/film captures an atmosphere** or that a **book/film deals with a topic**. We talk about the **opening/closing scenes** of a film and the **opening/closing chapters** of a book. We talk about the beginning and end of a **book/film** (NOT start and finish). If everything works out well for the central characters, we say that the **book/film has a happy ending**. You may recommend a book/film that you enjoyed to a friend. If a lot of people have enjoyed it, it is **highly recommended**.

sessions.title: B Just about films and acting
sessions.description_vi: Chỉ về phim ảnh và diễn xuất.
sessions.value:
# Films and books

## B Just about films and acting

I’ve never had any desire to go on the **stage**¹ myself but I’d love to produce a film. I think historical dramas work particularly well on the **big screen**² and I’d love to make a film about Vikings in Britain. There’d be plenty of opportunities to use **special effects**³ during battle scenes. I’d want the **male lead**⁴ to be played by Hugh Jackman, while Jennifer Lawrence could have the female lead. Liam Neeson could play the role of a Viking warrior and I’d like Judi Dench to take on a **cameo role**⁵. I’m sure that, as always, she would give an excellent **performance**. My dream is to make a film that would be nominated for an **Oscar**⁶. Of course, I’d also like it to be an immediate **box-office hit**⁷, playing to **full houses**⁸ worldwide.

¹ become an actor  
² the cinema  
³ powerful visual effects, often created using technology  
⁴ main male part  
⁵ small but special part  
⁶ put on the official list of people in the film world who may receive a special prize (an Oscar)  
⁷ extremely successful with audiences  
⁸ cinemas/theatres with no empty seats

Other strong collocations are **cast a film** [select the actors for a film], **star in a film**, **shoot a film**, **make a film**.

sessions.title: C Just about books, audiobooks and e-books
sessions.description_vi: Chỉ về sách, sách nói và sách điện tử.
sessions.value:
# Films and books

## C Just about books, audiobooks and e-books

| collocation                                  | example                                                                                                                                                           |
| -------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **be engrossed/absorbed in a book**              | Claudia was so engrossed/absorbed in her book that she didn’t hear me.                                                                                            |
| **compulsive reading**                           | Many people find articles about the private lives of film stars compulsive reading. [so interesting you can’t stop reading]                                       |
| **bedtime reading**                              | I don’t think a horror story makes good bedtime reading.                                                                                                          |
| **an easy read**                                 | Detective stories are good for train journeys as they’re an easy read.                                                                                            |
| **download an audiobook / an e-book reader app** | You can look up the latest book releases and download an audiobook from the iTunes store. I’ve just helped my mother download an e-book reader app on her tablet. |
| **flick/skim through a book**                    | Mona flicked/skimmed through the book without reading it in detail.                                                                                               |
| **beautifully written**                          | The book is beautifully written – I highly recommend it.                                                                                                          |

### Common mistakes

Critics **review** books and films, NOT **criticise** them. To criticise a book or film means to say negative things about it.
Remember that you **watch television**, NOT **see television**, but you can **see or watch a film or programme on television**. We usually say **see a film at the cinema**.

see a film at the cinema

image.value: person reviewing a book

senses.definition_vi: Người đánh giá sách.
examples: The book reviewers praised the novel for its intricate plot.

use_prompts.question: How do people decide which new novels to buy?
Have online customer comments replaced professional critics of novels?
What influences your choice when you buy a novel online?

dictation.text: The book reviewers loved her first novel.

paraphrase.source: People who write about new novels in newspapers praised the story.
paraphrase.model: Book reviewers praised the story.

paraphrase.source: Critics who judge new novels said the plot was too slow.
paraphrase.model: Book reviewers said the plot was too slow.

image.value: person reviewing a film

senses.definition_vi: Nhà phê bình phim.
examples: Film critics are often divided on the merits of the latest blockbuster.

use_prompts.question: Do you read professional opinions before going to the cinema?
Why do some popular movies get bad reviews from experts?
Has social media made professional movie reviewers less important?

dictation.text: Film critics loved the new comedy.

paraphrase.source: Experts who write about movies said it was the best of the year.
paraphrase.model: Film critics said it was the best of the year.

paraphrase.source: Professional movie reviewers did not like the ending.
paraphrase.model: Film critics did not like the ending.

image.value: review of a book or film

senses.definition_vi: Bài đánh giá sách/phim.
examples: The book/film reviews were overwhelmingly positive.

use_prompts.question: How do you choose which new novel or movie to try?
Do people trust online opinions about novels and movies?
Would you like a job writing about new novels and movies?

dictation.text: She writes book and film reviews for a newspaper.

paraphrase.source: Opinions in newspapers about both the novel and the movie were very positive.
paraphrase.model: The book and film reviews were very positive.

paraphrase.source: The magazine publishes critics' opinions on new novels and movies every week.
paraphrase.model: The magazine publishes book and film reviews every week.

image.value: book or film based on a true story

senses.definition_vi: Dựa trên một câu chuyện có thật.
examples: The movie is based on a true story of survival.

use_prompts.question: Why do people enjoy movies about real events?
Can historical dramas teach young people about the past?
Why are films about real-life heroes so popular?

dictation.text: The film is based on a true story.

paraphrase.source: The movie tells about real events that happened during the war.
paraphrase.model: The movie is based on a true story from the war.

paraphrase.source: The novel describes things that really happened to a poor family.
paraphrase.model: The novel is based on a true story about a poor family.

image.value: book or film capturing an atmosphere

senses.definition_vi: Sách/phim gợi lên một bầu không khí (cảm xúc, tâm trạng).
examples: The novel captures the atmosphere of post-war London perfectly.

use_prompts.question: What makes a historical film feel realistic?
Can novels or movies give you a real feeling of a foreign place?
Why do some stories set in the past feel so real?

dictation.text: The book and the film both capture the atmosphere well.

paraphrase.source: Both the novel and its movie version show very well how life felt in wartime London.
paraphrase.model: Both the book and the film capture the atmosphere of wartime London.

paraphrase.source: The novel and the movie make you feel the excitement of the busy market.
paraphrase.model: The book and the film capture the atmosphere of the busy market.

image.value: book or film dealing with a topic

senses.definition_vi: Sách/phim đề cập đến một chủ đề.
examples: The documentary deals with the topic of climate change.

use_prompts.question: Should schools use movies to teach difficult social issues?
What subjects do you think modern novels should explore?
Can movies change people's attitudes towards climate change?

dictation.text: The book and the film deal with the same topic.

paraphrase.source: The novel and its movie version are both about the subject of racism.
paraphrase.model: The book and the film both deal with the topic of racism.

paraphrase.source: Both the novel and the movie talk about the issue of poverty.
paraphrase.model: Both the book and the film deal with the topic of poverty.

image.value: opening or closing scenes of a film

senses.definition_vi: Các cảnh mở đầu/kết thúc của một bộ phim.
examples: The opening scenes of the film were particularly striking.

use_prompts.question: What makes a movie memorable for you?
Which parts of a film matter most to keep the audience interested?
How can teachers use the beginnings and endings of movies in lessons?

dictation.text: The opening and closing scenes take place on a beach.

paraphrase.source: The first and last parts of the movie were filmed in Paris.
paraphrase.model: The opening and closing scenes of the movie were filmed in Paris.

paraphrase.source: Both the start and the end of the film show the same empty street.
paraphrase.model: The opening and closing scenes of the film show the same empty street.

image.value: opening or closing chapters of a book

senses.definition_vi: Các chương mở đầu/kết thúc của một cuốn sách.
examples: The closing chapters of the book provided a satisfying conclusion.

use_prompts.question: How can a writer make readers keep reading a novel?
Should students read whole novels or only parts of them at school?
What makes the ending of a novel satisfying?

dictation.text: The opening and closing chapters are the most exciting.

paraphrase.source: The first and last parts of the novel are told by the same child.
paraphrase.model: The opening and closing chapters of the novel are told by the same child.

paraphrase.source: I loved the beginning and the end of the book, but the middle was slow.
paraphrase.model: I loved the opening and closing chapters, but the middle was slow.

image.value: a book or a film

senses.definition_vi: Sách hoặc phim.
examples: I enjoyed both the book and the film adaptation.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Không dùng 'start' và 'finish' cho sách/phim, mà dùng 'beginning' và 'end'.

use_prompts.question: Do you prefer reading a novel or watching its movie version?

paraphrase.model: I preferred the book to the film.

paraphrase.source: The story is famous as a novel and also as a movie.
paraphrase.model: The story is famous as both a book and a film.

image.value: a book or film with a happy ending

senses.definition_vi: Sách/phim có một kết thúc có hậu.

image.value: highly recommended book or film
